requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation is incomplete and not properly capturing request/response data. Tests are failing because HTTP/2 records are not being properly populated with URL, method, status code, and other attributes. The hook creates records but doesn't properly populate them with data from HTTP/2 connections.
requirement.contract: Fix the HTTP/2 hook implementation to properly capture and populate HTTP/2 records with all required information including URL, method, status code, headers, cookies, content, and protocol. The hook must correctly handle both synchronous and asynchronous HTTP/2 clients and ensure records are populated with complete data from HTTP/2 connections.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_request, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_response, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_cookies, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_redirect, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_not_found, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_many_requests, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_many_requests_session, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_server, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_server_only, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_server_request, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_server_response, tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_initiator

requirement.description: The HTTPX exception handling tests are failing due to incorrect exception recording. The tests expect exceptions to be recorded with proper exception objects, but the current implementation doesn't correctly store the exception information in the records.
requirement.contract: Update the HTTPX hook implementation to properly record exceptions with their full exception objects in the HTTP records. The exception recording must match the expected behavior in the test assertions, particularly for test_httpx_exception and test_httpx_exception_asyncclient.

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 record implementation has issues with URL construction and header parsing. The URL property isn't correctly extracting the full URL from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers, and the headers parsing logic is not robust enough to handle various HTTP/2 frame formats.
requirement.contract: Improve the HTTP/2 record implementation to correctly extract and reconstruct URLs from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers (:authority, :path) and properly parse HTTP/2 headers to populate request and response headers correctly.

requirement.description: The records module's add_new_record method is not correctly creating HTTP/2 records. The record_type parameter is not being properly used to instantiate the correct record type (HTTP2Record vs HTTP1Record).
requirement.contract: Fix the add_new_record method in HTTPRecords to properly instantiate HTTP2Record when record_type is "http2" and ensure HTTP1Record when record_type is "http1" or unspecified.

requirement.description: The hook_h2 context manager is not correctly handling the HTTP/2 connection lifecycle. Records are created but not properly populated with data during the HTTP/2 connection process.
requirement.contract: Ensure that HTTP/2 hook properly integrates with HTTP/2 connection handlers to populate records with data received from HTTP/2 connections. The hook must coordinate with the underlying HTTP/2 implementation to capture all request/response data.
